title: Multi-billion dollar propaganda book campaign

tellings.quote: But right next to them are the books that we publish full of propaganda. It's a multi-billion dollar campaign to cover up the truth.

plain: In 1981, an official named John S. Herrington is said to have described a secret publishing effort: next to the real books, he said, "are the books that we publish full of propaganda. It's a multi-billion dollar campaign to cover up the truth." The Hollywood writer Brent Friedman tells Michels what he says Herrington said. If true, it would mean much of what the public reads on the subject was planted to mislead.
